name: Exp_ColorZerolagDeMarker
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagDeMarker custom indicator, which is a zero-lag composite oscillator built from five weighted DeMarker indicators. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing and trade execution are handled through the included TradeAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagDeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标是一个由五个加权DeMarker指标合成的零滞后振荡器。当振荡器上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈水平。仓位管理和交易执行通过内置的TradeAlgorithms库处理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是零滞后DeMarker振荡器的交叉信号，通过五个不同周期（8、21、34、55、89）的DeMarker指标按不同权重（0.05、0.10、0.16、0.26、0.43）加权合成，旨在消除传统振荡器的滞后性。入场条件为：当Osc1上穿Osc2时产生买入信号，当Osc1下穿Osc2时产生卖出信号，交叉判断需要前后两根K线确认（Osc1[1]>Osc2[1]且Osc1[0]<Osc2[0]为买入交叉）。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和固定保证金两种模式。资金管理方面，止损止盈比例为1:2，但没有根据波动率或账户风险动态调整的机制。策略仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免了逐tick重复计算的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy revolves around crossover signals from a zero-lag DeMarker oscillator, which combines five DeMarker indicators with different periods (8, 21, 34, 55, 89) and weights (0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43) to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional oscillators. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 crosses above Osc2, and a sell signal is generated when Osc1 crosses below Osc2, requiring confirmation from two consecutive bars (e.g., Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] and Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] for a buy crossover). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels, with optional closing on reverse signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot and fixed margin modes via the TradeAlgorithms library. Money management features a 1:2 risk-reward ratio but lacks dynamic adjustment based on volatility or account risk percentage. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick computation.

pros: 零滞后设计通过多周期加权合成有效减少了传统振荡器的信号滞后问题
仅在新K线形成时计算信号，减少了计算开销和虚假信号
提供了独立的买卖开关控制，灵活性高，可以单独启用或禁用开仓和平仓
1:2的风险回报比设置合理，有利于长期正期望值
使用前后两根K线确认交叉信号，降低了虚假突破的风险
pros_en: Zero-lag design through multi-period weighted composition effectively reduces signal lag inherent in traditional oscillators
Signals are calculated only on new bar formation, reducing computational overhead and false signals
Independent buy/sell toggle controls provide high flexibility, allowing separate enabling/disabling of entry and exit
1:2 risk-reward ratio is reasonable and conducive to long-term positive expectancy
Two-bar crossover confirmation reduces the risk of false breakouts
cons: 止损止盈使用固定点数，不考虑市场波动率变化，在不同品种和行情下可能不适用
没有持仓检查机制，可能重复开仓或在没有预期的情况下叠加仓位
依赖外部自定义指标ColorZerolagDeMarker和TradeAlgorithms库，可移植性差
缺少点差过滤和交易时间限制，在点差过大或非活跃时段可能产生不利成交
DeMarker_period4为int类型而其他周期为uint类型，存在类型不一致的隐患
cons_en: Fixed point stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes, making them unsuitable across different instruments and market conditions
No position check mechanism exists, potentially leading to duplicate entries or unintended position stacking
Dependency on external custom indicator ColorZerolagDeMarker and TradeAlgorithms library reduces portability
Lacks spread filter and trading session restrictions, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
DeMarker_period4 uses int type while other periods use uint, indicating an inconsistency that could cause issues
improvements: 将固定点数止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动环境
增加持仓检查和最大持仓数量限制，防止重复开仓和过度暴露风险
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Replace fixed-point stop-loss and take-profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to varying market volatility
Add position checking and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and overexposure
Add spread filtering and trading session controls to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓导致风险叠加
固定止损1000点在极端行情下可能不足以覆盖跳空风险
缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利的入场价格
risk_points_en: No position check mechanism may lead to duplicate entries in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss may be insufficient to cover gap risk during extreme market conditions
Lack of spread filter may result in unfavorable entry prices during high-volatility periods when spreads widen
